article.headline: Noard scores 19 in Samford’s 74-64 win over South Carolina Upstate
article.description: — Cooper Noard’s 19 points helped Samford defeat South Carolina Upstate 74-64 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Noard scores 19 in Samford’s 74-64 win over South Carolina Upstate

categories.description: Samford Bulldogs @ South Carolina Upstate Spartans

event.description: Samford Bulldogs @ South Carolina Upstate Spartans

keywords: Samford Bulldogs @ South Carolina Upstate Spartans
article.story: GREENVILLE, S.C. -- — Cooper Noard’s 19 points helped Samford defeat South Carolina Upstate 74-64 on Wednesday. Noard shot 7 of 11 from the field, including 3 for 7 from 3-point range, and went 2 for 3 from the line for the Bulldogs (2-2). Will Shaver scored 15 points and added 11 rebounds. Cade Norris shot 3 for 8 (1 for 4 from 3-point range) and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. Amont’e Allen-Johnson led the Spartans (1-5) in scoring, finishing with 18 points. South Carolina Upstate also got 16 points and 12 rebounds from David Tubek. Miles Webb also had 14 points. Up next Up next for Samford is a Sunday matchup with UNC Asheville at home, and South Carolina Upstate visits UNC Greensboro on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
